narrative: Chart of Accounts administration — the HTB planning COA maps the group ledger across income statement, balance sheet and cash flow. AI Auto-Map suggests mappings for unmapped ledger accounts using Cortex, with high accuracy on standard banking lines such as interest income, interest expense and impairment.

signals.excerpt: Active ledger accounts mapped to planning leaf accounts; a small number of legacy HLF (former Wesleyan Bank) codes are under review.
